conjectures.statement: For any smooth solution of 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes in a periodic domain, the finite-time pointwise Lagrangian vorticity growth satisfies |omega(X(t), t)| <= |omega(X(0), 0)| * exp(int_0^t lambda_3(X(s), s) ds), where lambda_3 is the maximum eigenvalue of the strain-rate tensor S.
conjectures.derived_from: D|omega|/Dt = lambda_omega * |omega| + nu * omega_hat . Delta(omega) <= lambda_3 * |omega| (when viscous diffusion <= 0 or for inviscid Euler).
conjectures.missing_step_for_global_regularity: Proving an a priori L^1_t L^infty_x bound on lambda_3 without assuming regularity.

conjectures.statement: In homogeneous isotropic turbulence, vorticity preferentially aligns with the intermediate strain eigenvector e_2, providing an intrinsic geometric self-suppression mechanism that prevents optimal extensional growth (lambda_omega << lambda_3).
conjectures.derived_from: Observed mean alignment |omega_hat . e_2| approx 0.60 vs |omega_hat . e_3| approx 0.35 across all isotropic decay realizations.
conjectures.missing_step_for_global_regularity: Rigorous proof of e_2 alignment stability from the Navier-Stokes dynamical eigensystem equations.
